page.overview:
What is Rifle?

A rifle was a type of large firearm designed to be fired from the shoulder. Types of rifles included blaster rifles which fired bolts of intense light energy, and slugthrower rifles which fired solid projectiles. A concussion rifle discharged a concussion blast. The Tusken Cycler used by the Sand People of Tatooine was a slugthrower rifle.
